title: Blockchain-Based Academic Certificate Verification System
abstract: A decentralized platform for issuing and verifying student academic credentials using Ethereum smart contracts and QR codes to eliminate certificate forgery.

title: Crop Disease Detection using Deep Learning and Drone Imagery
abstract: A mobile-linked system that analyzes aerial drone photos of farmland using a fine-tuned YOLOv8 model to detect 12 types of crop disease with 91% accuracy.

title: AI-Powered Mental Health Chatbot for Students
abstract: A conversational chatbot that uses NLP sentiment analysis and CBT-based response templates to provide mental wellness support and escalation alerts for college students.

title: Personalized E-Learning Content Recommender
abstract: Recommends online course chapters and YouTube tutorials to students based on their quiz performance history using collaborative filtering and BERT embeddings.

title: Smart City Pothole Detection with Edge AI
abstract: Real-time pothole detection using a lightweight MobileNetV2 model deployed on a Raspberry Pi fitted to garbage vehicles to map road damage across city grids.

title: Deepfake Detection in Social Media Videos
abstract: A browser extension that flags AI-generated face-swapped videos using a CNN-LSTM model trained on the FaceForensics++ dataset.

title: Multilingual Legal Document Summarizer
abstract: Summarizes court orders and government circulars in English and Hindi using mT5 transformer fine-tuned on Indian legal corpus documents.

title: Stock Price Prediction using Transformer Architecture
abstract: A financial forecasting dashboard that uses Temporal Fusion Transformer on 5 years of NSE stock data to predict next-day price movements and confidence bands.

title: IoT-Based Smart Greenhouse Automation System

title: Sign Language to Text Converter using CNN and MediaPipe
abstract: Translates Indian Sign Language hand gestures captured by webcam into real-time English text using MediaPipe Hands and a fine-tuned EfficientNet classifier.

title: Automated Code Review Assistant using LLM
abstract: A VS Code extension that reviews GitHub pull requests and provides inline style
domain: and logic feedback by querying an LLM with code diffs.

title: Fraud Detection in UPI Transactions using Graph Neural Networks
abstract: Detects fraudulent UPI payment patterns in real time by modeling transaction networks as graphs and applying GNN anomaly scoring.
